verdict.rationale: Morph is an OpenAI-compatible model API, so a model-catalog endpoint is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence documents a GET /v1/models or any other way to list models programmatically. The docs only describe chat completions, the Anthropic Messages endpoint, and passing model names as strings. Probes also found no OpenAPI spec that might have listed such an endpoint, and general OpenAI-SDK compatibility does not establish that the catalog endpoint exists.
